Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Combo Timer (Wayne)
Punchline: Combo countdown, enemy information, distance, FPS and ping in one plugin.
Description: Seven independently switchable modules: combo timer, enemy-list HP, enemy-list statuses, target distance, personal target-status enlargement, FPS and ping. Existing settings are imported automatically on the first upgrade, including saved Ping window positions. Open /waynecombo for settings.
